about_the_game:
Car radio #12.

Contains a lot of Wild West schlagers from someone under the alias Daddy Scrubber (Papasha Scrubber), which were recorded at some point in the early 1990's and were lost until December 2020.

Also doubles as a donate button - by purchasing this exact OST, you are sponsoring the authors of the game personally (30%) and the creation of Captain Gazman 2: Dawn Of The Rage (70%).
